title: Netflix Korea 2026: Every Original Coming This Year
description: Netflix Korea's 2026 lineup is their most ambitious yet. Here's every confirmed original series, film, and documentary coming this year.
content:
Netflix has invested over $500 million in Korean content for 2026, making it the streaming giant's biggest commitment to a single country's creative industry. The lineup reflects this investment — ambitious, diverse, and star-studded.

Confirmed Originals — Series

Q1 2026

  • "Kingdom: Resurrection" — The zombie historical saga returns for its fourth season. Bigger budget, new characters, same terrifying tension.
  • "Parasite: The Series" — Based on Bong Joon-ho's Oscar-winning film. A prequel exploring the Park family before the events of the film.

Q2 2026

  • "Squid Game: Season 4" — The global phenomenon continues. New games, new players, familiar dread.
  • "Hangang Blues" — Multi-generational family saga across 50 years of Seoul history.

Q3-Q4 2026

  • "All of Us Are Dead: Season 2" — The high school zombie apocalypse returns
  • "Hellbound: Season 2" — Supernatural thriller continues
  • "My Mister: A New Story" — Spiritual sequel to the beloved 2018 drama
💡 Travel Tip: Netflix often holds cast events and fan screenings in Seoul near premiere dates. Check Netflix Korea's Instagram for event announcements.

Feature Films

  • "Han: The Movie" — Park Chan-wook directs. A psychological thriller. Enough said.
  • "Seoul Station Midnight" — Animation from Studio Mir (The Legend of Korra). Adult psychological horror.
